title: Heaven Harp

style.look: stylized 3D animated feature film look (soft subsurface skin, expressive faces, detailed curly hair, cloth simulation), vertical 9:16
style.character_style: stylized 3D animated feature film character render
style.background_style: stylized 3D animated feature film background, soft volumetric light
style.lighting: Heaven: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist. Hospital: mid-morning, warm blind-striped sunlight on pale blue walls, turquoise-green fill
style.physics: slightly exaggerated cartoon physics, readable comedic timing
style.palette: Heaven: tangerine 60% / bright yellow 30% / turquoise 10%. Hospital: tangerine 60% / chartreuse 30% / turquoise-green 10%
rules: The narrator wears a pale blue hospital gown and is barefoot in every Heaven shot; in the hospital he wears a pale blue hospital gown in bed.
The harp is one ornate golden floor harp; once broken it stays broken (3 loose strings, snapped column, split base).
Mouths may move on dialogue, but there is no spoken audio; the voice-over is added in post.

locks: No spoken dialogue or narration audio - SFX and ambience only.
Every character appears only once in the frame - never two copies of the same person (no over-the-shoulder double).

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.role: the new arrival, an atheist who just died in surgery
narrator.description: Young man, bright orange voluminous curly hair, dark auburn eyebrows, fair freckled skin, heterochromatic eyes (blue viewer-left, green viewer-right), lean build. Pale blue hospital gown, barefoot.
narrator.age: an adult man in his mid-twenties (adult face, defined jaw, adult height and proportions, not a teenager or child)

harpist.name: Harpist angel
harpist.role: the angel whose harp he breaks; his calm guide
harpist.description: Slender young woman angel, auburn hair coiled at the nape, calm grey eyes, tall cream-grey wings, floor-length pale oatmeal linen robe with thin gold cord, bare feet.
harpist.age: a young adult woman in her mid-twenties

family.name: Arriving parents
family.role: a mother and father arriving at the gate with their daughter
family.description: Mother and father in their thirties in navy and warm brown everyday clothes; daughter about seven, two dark braids with yellow ties, red cardigan over pale yellow dress, grey canvas shoes.
family.age: a mother and father in their early thirties

surgeon.name: Surgeon
surgeon.role: his surgeon in the recovery room
surgeon.description: Woman in her forties, dark hair under a teal scrub cap, round glasses, teal scrubs, mask at her chin, hospital badge, clipboard.

harp.name: Harp
harp.role: the ONLY harp at Heaven's gate
harp.description: Ornate golden floor harp, carved pale-gold column, glowing silver strings, small brass pedals.

heaven_gate.name: Heaven's gate
heaven_gate.role: pale stone landing on a cloud bank before an open golden gate
heaven_gate.description: Pale stone paving on a cloud bank, tall filigreed pale gold gate standing open, mist, bright sky, harp on a dais, a crowd of angels in ivory/dove-grey robes and new arrivals in muted street clothes.

hospital.name: Recovery bay
hospital.description: Bed with chrome rails, cardiac monitor, IV stand, pale green curtain, blind-striped light on pale blue walls.

daughter.name: Daughter
daughter.description: Girl about seven, two dark braids with yellow ties, red cardigan over pale yellow dress, grey canvas shoes.
daughter.age: a girl about seven years old

shots.narration: I died an atheist during heart surgery and woke up outside Heaven's gate.
shots.context: The narrator stands barefoot in a pale blue hospital gown on the pale stone landing before the open golden gate, staring up in disbelief; a calm row of angels stands just inside the gate, the harp small on its dais to one side.
shots.camera: Wide shot, low angle, slow tilt up from his bare feet to his face.

beats.action: Tilt up from his bare feet to his astonished face.
He clutches the open back of his gown, eyes darting over the gate and the silent angels.

shots.sfx: soft heavenly ambience, wind, distant harp music
shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: I accidentally bumped into the angel playing the harp. CRASH! The music stopped.
shots.context: The narrator trips on the hem of his gown and crashes chest-first into the tall golden harp while the harpist angel falls backward off her stool.

beats.action: He stumbles forward over his gown hem, arms flailing.
He slams chest-first into the harp; three strings spring loose.
The angel tumbles backward off her stool, wings flaring; the music stops dead.

shots.sfx: harp music, crash, twang of strings, sudden silence
shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: Three strings hung loose. I lifted the harp by its column, and a piece snapped off in my hand. CRACK! The base split.
shots.context: Half-crouched over the leaning harp, the narrator grabs its carved column to lift it; a piece of the column snaps off in his hands and the base splits open on the stone.
shots.camera: Medium shot, high angle, slow push in.

beats.action: Three loose strings swing; he grips the column with both hands and starts lifting.
CRACK - a chunk of the column snaps off in his grip.
The base splits and the harp settles crooked.
He freezes mid-crouch, horrified, staring at the broken piece; the angel sits stunned behind him.

shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: Every angel and new arrival turned toward me. The harpist stared at what was left of her instrument.
shots.context: Across the landing every angel and new arrival turns to stare at the narrator, who stands small by the dais hugging the splintered column; the harpist kneels by the wrecked harp.
shots.camera: Wide shot, eye level, slow pull out.

beats.action: Heads turn in a ripple toward him across the crowd.
The harpist kneels over the shattered harp, staring at it; he hugs the column to his chest, eyes darting.

shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: "That was the ONLY harp at Heaven's gate." I wanted to disappear. How was I supposed to make this right?
shots.context: Kneeling beside the shattered harp, the harpist lifts her face and speaks; the narrator shrinks back clutching the broken column like a shield under the disappointed stares of the angels.

beats.action: The harpist, hands hovering over the wreck, lifts her face and speaks.
Cut of attention to him shrinking back, the column clutched to his chest.

shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: I had spent my life insisting this place didn't exist. Now they probably wished I didn't exist.
shots.context: The narrator looks down at his bare feet on the glowing stone, cheeks red with embarrassment, avoiding the stern gaze of the tall angels around him.
shots.camera: Medium close-up, high angle looking down on him.

beats.action: He bows his head, one toe scuffing the stone, cheeks and ears flushing red.
The camera rises to reveal tall angels standing above him, staring down at him in silence.

shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: "Can't someone here fix it?" The harpist pointed to spare strings. "That's not how things work here. Only the person who broke it can repair it. I can guide you, but I can't touch it."
shots.context: A heap of glowing silver strings on a cloud pedestal in the foreground; the harpist stands by her broken harp, hands behind her back, nodding toward the strings as she speaks to the narrator.
shots.camera: Two shot, eye level, rack focus from the strings to her face.

beats.action: He asks hopefully, gesturing at the broken harp.
She nods her chin toward the pedestal of glowing spare strings.
She explains calmly, hands clasped firmly behind her back, never touching the harp.
Hold on her steady, patient look.

shots.sfx: gentle hum of the glowing strings
shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: A family reached the gate. Their daughter looked at the silent harp. "Why isn't anyone playing?" The answer traveled fast. "The new arrival broke it."
shots.context: A family arrives at the gate; their little daughter points across the paving at the silent harp while her parents and nearby souls whisper and shake their heads at the narrator.
shots.camera: Medium shot, low angle, push in.

beats.action: The family steps through the open gate.
The daughter notices the silent broken harp.
She points at it and asks a question, mouth moving.
Whispers pass down the line of angels and arrivals.
Heads shake, glances turn toward the narrator by the far dais.

shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: Everyone watched as I threaded a string where the harpist pointed. PING! It whipped my nose. My gown caught a pedal, and I landed on my face.
shots.context: Sitting cross-legged at the broken harp, the narrator threads a glowing string where the harpist points; it snaps back across his nose and he topples, his gown catching a pedal, landing flat on his face.

beats.action: He carefully threads the glowing string at the tuning pin.
PING - the string whips across his nose; his head snaps back.
His gown snags on a pedal as he flails for balance.
He falls flat on his face on the stone and lies there a beat.

shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: "Careful with the column." After a few tries, I secured ONE string. Two remained. Then the gates began to FADE.
shots.context: Sitting cross-legged, the narrator carefully ties one glowing string to its tuning pin; behind him the golden gate turns translucent and starts to fade.
shots.camera: Medium shot, eye level, rack focus from his hands to the fading gate.

beats.action: The harpist warns him, pointing at the cracked column.
He ties one glowing string to its pin and lets out a small relieved breath.
Behind him the golden gate turns translucent and starts to fade.

shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: The harpist looked up. "Your heart started again." I stared at the broken harp. "But I'm not finished."
shots.context: Kneeling at the dais, the narrator reaches desperately toward the cracked harp as his hands begin to glow and dissolve into particles of light; the harpist looks down at him.

beats.action: The harpist looks up toward the sky.
His fingertips begin to glow.
He stares at the broken harp.
He reaches for it desperately as his hands dissolve into motes of light.

shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: "Then Heaven stays quiet until you return." One by one, the angels shook their heads.
shots.context: The harpist folds her arms and sighs over the fading narrator, who is half light; the angels behind turn their backs on him one by one, shaking their heads.
shots.camera: Wide shot, eye level, pull out.

beats.action: She folds her arms and speaks quietly down to him.
One by one the angels turn their backs, shaking their heads, as he fades to light.

shots.lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist

shots.narration: BEEP. BEEP. "SORRY!" I woke in recovery. My surgeon smiled. "The operation was successful."
shots.context: The narrator gasps and jolts upright in the hospital bed, pulling his oxygen mask down; the surgeon at the foot of the bed holds a clipboard and smiles.

beats.action: He gasps and jolts upright, yanking the oxygen mask to his chin.
He looks around the recovery room, stunned.
The surgeon at the foot of the bed smiles.
She nods warmly as she speaks.

shots.lighting: mid-morning, warm blind-striped sunlight on pale blue walls, turquoise-green fill

test_takes.review: ends on old S14 frame with duplicate narrator (over-the-shoulder double) - redo after new S14 keyframe

shots.narration: I reached for my phone. "Calling your family?" "I'm finding someone who can teach me harp repair."
shots.context: Still hooked up to an IV, the narrator sits up in bed typing feverishly on his smartphone while the surgeon at the foot of the bed watches, confused.
shots.camera: Medium two shot, eye level: the narrator sharp in the lower-left foreground in bed with his phone, the surgeon behind at the foot of the bed.

beats.action: He grabs his phone from the bedside.
The surgeon tilts her head and asks a question.
He types fast without looking up.
Her clipboard lowers, one eyebrow raised, confused.

shots.lighting: mid-morning, warm blind-striped sunlight on pale blue walls, turquoise-green fill

shots.narration: I had a second chance at life and a broken harp waiting for me at the end of it.
shots.context: In the sunlit recovery bed the narrator smiles determinedly at his phone screen, which shows search results for instrument repair classes.
shots.camera: Medium close-up, slow push in, hold.

beats.action: His eyes scan the phone screen.
A small determined smile spreads across his face.
He settles back into the pillow, holding the phone; hold.

shots.lighting: mid-morning, warm blind-striped sunlight on pale blue walls, turquoise-green fill

format: narrated short - first-person narrator VO over the whole film, dialogue lines read in VO (no lip sync), burned subtitles
vo_post: compress pauses >0.45s to 0.35s (silenceremove), trim edges; narration mixed over shot SFX, SFX ducked
